title: EmailSenderSuccessResponse
description: Response returned when an email is sent (or replayed from the idempotency store) successfully.

ok.description: Always true on a successful send.

idempotency_key.description: The idempotency key that was enforced.

tenant_id.description: The SME whose mailbox was used.

invoice_ref.description: The invoice this message relates to.

rendered_subject.description: The subject line after template rendering.

rendered_body_preview.description: First ~200 characters of the rendered body, kept for audit.

thread_id.description: The thread the message was attached to, or null if a new conversation was started.
